verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a Full Export in Settings, including scheduled automated full exports. Exported data uses open formats: properties become Markdown front matter and collections become CSV files, described as human- and machine-readable for reuse in other apps. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that media and attachments are included in the full export, and independent or hands-on corroboration of export completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: All your properties are transformed into front matter values, all collections are stored as CSV files, making it easy to reuse your content in other apps or work with it programmatically.
Exports from Capacities are fully human- and machine-readable at the same time.
You can schedule automatic exports by going to `Settings > Full Export > Automated Full Export > Add Schedule`.
